families.evidence: Every non-DCT primary transform value observed by the corpus has reviewed syntax, coefficient-profile, geometry, and inverse-reconstruction coverage.
All production luma-prediction frontiers advance through the shared IDIF, cardinal, Smooth, or Paeth paths; exhaustive zero-angle geometry coverage remains incomplete.
All six nonzero chroma angle deltas are validated across every directional mode and legal chroma prediction geometry, with shared IDIF matrix coverage and pinned live artifact vectors.
MRL indices 1, 2, and 3 are validated across every directional mode, luma angle delta, legal prediction geometry, multi-line state, and IBP state, with synthetic and live artifact coverage.

The binary multi-line feature is validated across every directional mode, luma angle delta, nonzero MRL index, legal prediction geometry, and IBP state, with exact cardinal, synthetic, and live artifact coverage.

Derived alpha, explicit plane-specific alpha, and all MHCCP directions are validated across every legal chroma coefficient geometry, all normative downsample filters, boundary states, live parsing, and exact artifact vectors.

Validated across all five legal luma geometries and all four coefficient Q contexts, with complete normative BOB, base, range, and sign CDF coverage, synthetic coefficient decoding, live parsing, and exact IDTX reconstruction.
The census observes chroma FSC metadata, but decoder support has not yet been audited independently.

Normative spatial and reference-bank block-vector prediction, DRL selection, both IntraBC modes, every legal skipped-copy geometry, residual transforms, reconstructed-source validation, and pinned multi-leaf parsing/output are covered.
IntraBC transform skip is validated for both IntraBC modes across every legal luma transform geometry, including full-output copying for reduced-coefficient 64-wide transforms.

The two observed luma palette blocks are covered with normative size, 8-bit color-table, row-identity, color-index-map, predictor, and residual reconstruction paths; pinned AVM confirms empty neighbor caches and exact size-2/size-6 color/map hashes.
Secondary-transform syntax and selected IST kernels exist; this corpus has no nonzero secondary-transform occurrence.
